title: Greek-Sahidic statistical aligner comparison + learning curves (JAK-36)

notes: Coptic = bound-group-v1 (v2 token ids); Greek = whitespace v1 ids.
Omission (John 8 PA) excluded from positive bitext.
Holdout units are never used as the training subset.
Thomas 7 / P.Oxy. 654 remain outside this NT training stack.

eflomal.name: eflomal
eflomal.detail: eflomal Python package importable; binary at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/eflomal

fast_align.name: fast_align
fast_align.detail: fast_align at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/fast_align; atools at /agent/repos/thomas/data/local/aligners/atools (optional; pure-Python symmetrize used)

human_reference.scoring: positional parent-v1 identity via char-span projection; match (unit_id, left_token_id, right_norm); no substring

eflomal.protocol: out-of-sample: eflomal train-only → Dirichlet priors → score-set align with frozen priors

intrinsic.notes: fwd_rev_agreement = |fwd&rev| / |fwd U rev| per sentence, averaged. density = symmetrized links / (src_len * trg_len). fertility = symmetrized links / src_len.

notes: eflomal Gibbs sampler uses OS entropy; seed is recorded for config provenance but does not fully pin C RNG.
Source=Sahidic (bound-group tokens), target=Greek (whitespace).
No LLM; offline after setup.
Aligned with frozen Dirichlet priors from train_76.priors.
OOS: priors estimated on train only; applied to unseen score set.

norm_gold.notes: Positional parent-v1 identity: predicted bound-group tokens are projected onto whitespace parent ids via char spans; match key is (unit_id, left_token_id, right_norm). No substring membership. Repeated parents (e.g. ⲡ) cannot cross-match. Provisional gold — intrinsic agreement remains the primary bake-off metric.

notes: OOS apply: frozen train co-occurrence table; greedy 1-best + symmetrize.

rationale: Jake decided (JAK-36 / PR #15): keep both eflomal and fast_align for the rest of Phase 2; do not adopt a single aligner yet.
eflomal evaluated first per PLAN.md / JAK-36; not preselected.
Identical v3 train/dev/holdout + bound-group-v1 segmentation for both.
Metrics are out-of-sample (train-only fit → apply to unseen dev/holdout).
Full-train dev fwd↔rev agreement: eflomal=0.5446, fast_align=0.1287 (Δ=+0.4159).
Intrinsic margin does not override Jake's keep-both dual-path call.

limitations: Provisional gold is tiny / unreviewed; intrinsic agreement is primary.
eflomal C sampler is stochastic; seed recorded but not fully pinning.
Dev/holdout curves are out-of-sample: fit on train only, apply to unseen score sets (eflomal priors; fast_align frozen lexical table).
Upstream aligner commits are pinned in aligner_pins / versions.json.
No LLM. Greek = Vaticanus B* only. PA omission never positive pairs.
Thomas 7 / P.Oxy. 654 excluded from training stack.
